title: Understanding Residual Plots
text: A residual plot shows the residuals on the vertical axis and the predicted values on the horizontal axis. It helps to assess the fit of a regression model.

title: Interpreting Residual Plots
text: In a good fit, the residuals should be randomly scattered around the horizontal axis. This indicates that the model captures the data well.

title: Identifying Patterns
text: If there is a pattern in the residual plot, such as a curve or a trend, it suggests that the model is not capturing some aspect of the data.
